blocks.text: Jab safed (white) light kisi compound par parti hai to ho sakta hai woh poori absorb (jazb) ho jaye, aur complex kaala dikhe. Ya compound saari light wapas (reflect) kar de ya guzar (transmit) jane de, aur safed dikhe. Teesri soorat: compound light ka kuch hissa absorb kare aur baqi reflect kare; tab complex us reflect hone wali light ke rang ka dikhta hai. Kitab ke mutabiq spectrum ke visible hisse mein light ke absorption aur emission se rang paida hota hai, is colour scheme ke mutabiq (Figure 18.6).
Jo rang hum dekhte hain woh absorb hone wali light ke rang ka ulat (complementary colour) hota hai. Maslan jo complex peeli (yellow) light absorb kare woh violet (banafshi) dikhta hai.

blocks.alt: Chhe barabar hisson wala rangon ka pahiya: oopar Orange, phir ghari ki sooiyon ki simt Yellow, Green, Blue, Violet aur Red. Aamne saamne ke hisse complementary rang hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.6: Complementary rang dikhane wala rangon ka pahiya (kitab ki Figure 18.6 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jo rang absorb hota hai, us ke aamne saamne wala rang nazar aata hai. Yellow absorb ho to violet dikhta hai, orange absorb ho to blue, red absorb ho to green; aur ulat bhi: violet absorb ho to yellow, blue absorb ho to orange, green absorb ho to red.

Kam energy wale d-orbital ke electrons light absorb kar ke zyada energy wale d-orbital mein chale jate hain (excite hote hain). Electron ke is transition (chhalang) mein lagne wali light ki energy complex ka khaas rang banati hai. Jo light absorb nahi hoti woh aage guzar jati hai aur wohi rang tay karti hai. Is process (amal) ko d-d transition kehte hain. d-d transition ki energy visible light ki ek khaas frequency (ν) aur wavelength (λ) ke barabar hoti hai, Planck's equation ke mutabiq: ΔE = hν = hc/λ (h Planck's constant aur c light ki speed (raftaar) hai).
Effect of Different Ligands on ΔE and Colour (alag alag ligands ka ΔE aur rang par asar)

Ligand ki type splitting ΔE ke magnitude (miqdar) par asar karti hai. NH₃ aur CN⁻ jaise ligands zyada splitting karte hain (energy gap ΔE barhta hai), jab ke Cl⁻ aur I⁻ jaise ligands ke saath ΔE chhota hota hai. Zyada ΔE ka matlab hai ke zyada frequency (chhoti wavelength) wali, violet ya blue, light absorb hogi; is ke muqable mein yellow light reflect ho kar compound peela dikhta hai. Kuch complexes kam energy wali (red/orange) light absorb karte hain aur complementary scheme ke mutabiq blue ya green dikhte hain. Ligands ko d-orbital splitting ki salahiyat ke mutabiq (zyada ΔE se kam ΔE) is order (tarteeb) mein rakha jata hai:

blocks.text_alt: CN⁻ > en > NH₃ > H₂O > OH⁻ > Cl⁻ > Br⁻ > I⁻

blocks.prompt: a) Ligands ki presence (maujoodgi) complex ion mein d-orbitals ki degeneracy par kaise asar karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Ligands ka electric field paanch degenerate d orbitals ko alag alag energy ke do non-degenerate sets mein baant deta hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Octahedral aur tetrahedral complexes ki d-orbital splitting mein basic farq kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono mein paanch d orbitals do sets mein bat jate hain, lekin order ulta hai:

blocks.prompt: c) Absorb hone wali light ki energy (ΔE) aur nazar aane wale rang ka relation (talluq) Planck's equation (ΔE = hν = hc/λ) se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Zyada ΔE ka matlab zyada frequency aur chhoti wavelength wali light absorb hoti hai; nazar aane wala rang absorb hone wali light ka complementary rang hai.

blocks.prompt: d) Cl⁻ wala complex red/orange light absorb karta hai. Yeh kis rang ka dikhega?
blocks.explanation: Blue se green, jo orange aur red ke complementary rang hain.

blocks.prompt: e) Transition metal compounds ke rang ke zimmedar d-d transitions samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Split hue d orbitals mein neeche wale set ka electron ΔE ke barabar energy wala photon absorb kar ke upar wale set mein jata hai; woh rang white light se nikal jata hai aur baqi rang nazar aata hai.

items: Nazar aane wala rang = absorb hone wali light ka complementary rang.
Splitting: CN⁻ > en > NH₃ > H₂O > OH⁻ > Cl⁻ > Br⁻ > I⁻.
